title: The Eightfold Script
subtitle: The Greater rite of the Scriptorium
text: At the fifth Degree, seat the Scriptorium two blocks north of a Cardinal Focus on a Greater working floor. Load one of each enzyme and empty its item, lapis, and shard slots. Bring a Vicar's Consecration Kit, a block of lapis, and a Blood Crystal Shard to the lit braziers. Consecrate twenty boundary anchors, seal the daemon, then feed fifty millilitres into each of the eight floor orbs. The writing must reach every tube before the ordinary ordeal begins. The completed rite binds the chained book and Vicar hardware without discarding what the station holds.
